title: Influence of Neuromuscular Fatigue Accumulated During Training on Subsequent Chronic Adaptations: PROTECT-10
official: Influence of Neuromuscular Fatigue Accumulated During Training on Subsequent Chronic Adaptations: PROTECT-10
summary: A 13-week longitudinal experimental study designed to determine how the level of neuromuscular fatigue induced by strength training influences chronic adaptations. Four assessment periods (pre-protocol, mid-point 1, mid-point 2, and post-protocol) will be used to measure neuromuscular, physiological, and structural parameters. A reference group will be included to assess measurement variability across the evaluation phases (this group will only undergo these assessments), while an experimental group will follow a standardized training protocol (in addition to the assessment phases).
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Man or woman between 18 and 45 years of age
* Active lifestyle (assessed via the GPAQ-2 questionnaire, with a minimum threshold defined as 600 MET-minutes per week)
* Capable of understanding the objectives and risks associated with the research and providing informed consent-dated and signed-in the judgment of the investigator
* Affiliated with a social security scheme

Exclusion Criteria:

* Known neurological, neuromuscular, cardiovascular, respiratory, or psychiatric condition
* Minors, adults under legal protection, or individuals unable to provide informed consent personally; high-level athletes or those undergoing strength-based training
* Pregnant or breastfeeding women
* Individuals in an emergency situation
